# asc_ip_allocation (Resource)

Allocates a reserved IP address to a virtual machine as a public IP.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "asc_ip" "example" {}

resource "asc_ip_allocation" "example" {
  vm_name = asc_virtual_machine.example.name
  ip      = asc_ip.example.ip
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) IPv4 address to allocate. It must already be reserved, typically by asc_ip.
- `vm_name` (String) Name of the virtual machine to allocate the address to. Moving an address to another machine deallocates it and allocates it again, so this forces replacement.
